Abstract.

LLM-based verification systems repair Rust proofs by revising programs in response to Verus diagnostics. 1. Introduction

Verus (Lattuada et al., 2023) verifies Rust (Matsakis and Klock, 2014) programs against formal specifications, using proof annotations to help an SMT solver discharge the resulting obligations.
